rule: Peri-workout cues: pre 30-60 g carbs + sodium 60-90 min out (+ beet juice and matcha); during per the intra rule; after 40 g protein + carbs within 2 h; easy/rest days protein at each meal (4 meals) and magnesium at night
summary: The pre-session carbohydrate and post-session protein (immediately to 2 h, 20-40 g, spread every 3-4 h) cues match the ISSN nutrient-timing stand. 40 g after whole-body resistance training stimulated more muscle protein synthesis than 20 g in trained men. A timing meta-analysis found total daily protein, not timing, drives hypertrophy, so the 2 h window is a convenience, not a requirement. Beet-juice nitrate gives a small effect (d≈0.17) in recreationally active men and none in well-trained endurance athletes, so the cue is harmless but probably small for him. Magnesium and matcha are supplement context the coach doesn't change.

sources.note: ISSN: 20-40 g protein every 3-4 h; post-exercise protein immediately-2 h stimulates MPS; pre-exercise meal size affects post-exercise needs
40 g vs 20 g whey after whole-body RT: greater MPS in resistance-trained men
Protein timing has no independent effect once total protein is controlled
Aragon & Schoenfeld 2013: the 'anabolic window' is wider than often claimed and depends on the pre-workout meal
Nitrate: small ergogenic effect (d=0.17) in recreationally active men; none in well-trained (>=65 ml/kg/min) athletes

value_at_review.pre: Pre: 30-60 g carbs + sodium (LMNT) 60-90 min out; beet juice + matcha
value_at_review.after: after: 40 g protein + carbs within 2 h
value_at_review.easy_day: Easy day: normal meals, protein at each; magnesium tonight.
value_at_review.rest_day: Rest day: protein spread over 4 meals; magnesium tonight.
